definition.clamp: no probability clipping, intercept cap, or wd clamp on this configured path; unrepresentable probabilities raise
definition.metric: negative log probability mass of positive integer observed duration
definition.normalization: CDF bin mass over raw duration unit; time_scale handled inside standardized log boundaries; no separate density Jacobian
definition.precision: float64 probability and conditional head calculations

limitations: Stored predictions contain no true dt, predicted duration, conditional mu or sigma; no duration association or head failure cause can be identified here.
Nonnegative integer-mass NLL should not be interpreted as the historical clamped RMTPP score or continuous lognormal density.
Observed quantity/time tradeoffs do not identify causal effects of representation, optimization or checkpoint selection.
Three seed descriptive SD is not a significance or equivalence test.
No Test artifacts, checkpoints, GPU, model inference or remote processes accessed.

method.aggregation: mean and sample SD ddof=1 across three seeds, never pooled targets
method.paired_delta: candidate minus baseline; positive is worse
method.quantiles: numpy linear; computed separately for each seed
